name: Sedona
tagline: Red rock towers, trails and desert sunsets
summary: Sedona sits among towering red sandstone buttes in the Arizona desert. Hike to Cathedral Rock and Devil's Bridge, drive the red rock scenic byway, see the Chapel of the Holy Cross built into the cliffs, wade in Oak Creek Canyon and watch the rocks glow at sunset under some of the darkest night skies in the US.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are ideal; summer is hot with afternoon storms.
arrival: About 2 hours by car from Phoenix airport, or 45 minutes from Flagstaff.
gettingAround: A car is needed; a free trail shuttle runs to the busiest trailheads.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere. Tip 18 to 20 percent at restaurants.
foodTip: Southwestern food with green chile, prickly pear margaritas.
buyTip: Native American jewellery and art at Tlaquepaque.
